blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Reviewed 2026-10-19. Ethereum is 100% of census circulating supply. The sole share token 0xbe53a109b494e5c9f97b9cd39fe969be68bf6204 is a fixed EIP-1167 clone of verified YearnV3Vault 0x1ab62413e0cf2ebeb73da7d40c70e7202ae14467, not an admin-upgradeable token. At Ethereum block 26224759 (2026-10-19T06:13:59+00:00), hash 0x2e777b94fc023c9fffa581f3cac554f363407ab8706bc77304323de6ba0f7993, asset() was canonical USDC, withdraw_limit_module() and deposit_limit_module() were zero, isShutdown() was false, and role_manager() was 0xb3bd6b2e61753c311efbcf0111f75d29706d9a41 (manager governance 0x88ba032be87d5ef1fbe87336b7090767f367bf73). The implementation has no current holder blacklist, arbitrary-holder seizure, forced burn or share-transfer pause; shutdown_vault stops deposits, not ERC20 transfers. However, role_manager can assign WITHDRAW_LIMIT_MANAGER, whose set_withdraw_limit_module can install an owner-sensitive limiter enforced by _redeem and maxWithdraw. This mutable holder-facing redemption surface sets Possible even while unset. USDC exposure remains inherited through variantOf/mintAuthority and the declared 100% USDC strategy book, but direct Possible takes precedence. The old true/Yes flag was unsupported and contradicted its own Upstream prose.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: yvUSDC-1 is the Ethereum-native Yearn v3 USDC vault share. Its deposit and mint functions create vault shares against USDC deposits; this deployment is not a cross-chain bridge representation.
bridgeRouteRisk.sourceFreeRationale: The tracked yvUSDC-1 vault is a single Ethereum Yearn vault; bridge-route risk is inherited from underlying USDC routes, not this vault contract.

routes.reviewNote: Ethereum block 26095933: asset() returned USDC, decimals() returned 6, and the immutable EIP-1167 clone targets verified YearnV3Vault 0x1ab62413e0cf2ebeb73da7d40c70e7202ae14467. Shares are issued through deposit and mint accounting on this canonical vault.
